season: Game 1.4.002 (after the 2026-09-23 update) · Crumble Dungeon weekly boards closing Wednesdays 00:00 KST
lede: What top Korean players post in Crumble Dungeon (크럼블 던전), the daily score attack against the Holy Golden Drop (황금갓방울): the rules, the scores, and the lineup rules behind them. Taken from DCInside, the official Naver cafe, KR YouTube and EOG's global hub; every claim links to its post.
caveat: Snapshot of 2026-09-28. No site publishes a Crumble Dungeon ranking: scores come from players' own screenshots and videos, one server's board at a time. The top lineups are published as rules and roster screenshots, rarely as named lists with levels. Scores are ranked by damage; the power shown is the whole collection's total power, and score ÷ power is only a normaliser.
footer: Built from the research record's evidence captures.

you.summary: Crumble Dungeon is won in the lineup screen, not the fight: make Milk captain with the top ATK, route Pomegranate's beam down a chosen ATK order (Scorpion or Brightseeker, then Figure and Macaron), keep supports at about Lv.70 so Milk reaches the centre first, and level every charger, summoner and Projectile Speed recipient out of the top 40. Then spend keys on retries: the same lineup swings by tens of G.
changes: Captain Milk; perks Passion Pay plus Rapid Promotion (or Like A Family) at mercenary Lv.4.

Set the ATK order first (Milk, then Scorpion or Brightseeker, Figure, Macaron, Melon Soda or Cheesecake) by lowering dealers' levels; the rest of the 40 only need to stay above the excluded cookies in power.
Level every cookie on the Exclusions page to Lv.1, Bari included.
Use the arena-style preset (Skill Haste, Skill AMP, crit, damage reduction; no accuracy or focus), and try one move-speed line if Milk arrives late.
Run at least once a day: the daily board pays only on days with a run, and the weekly board keeps only the best.

crumble_dungeon.lede: Crumble Dungeon (크럼블 던전, 'Challenge Dungeon' tab): every owned cookie fights the Holy Golden Drop for a timed run scored on total damage, ranked daily and weekly per server.
crumble_dungeon.caveat: The fight length (up to a minute) and the boss's patterns come from the community wiki, not an official notice; players' countdown marks (about 53 s, 20 s, 15 s, 8 s) fit it. The boss's damage-reduction steps are EOG's model, not published data. Guides say three entries a day while September lobby screens read a counter out of 5.

rules.title: Entry and keys
rules.body: Entered from the Dungeon menu's Challenge Dungeon (도전 던전) tab with a Crumble Dungeon Key. The wiki and the Naver newbie guide give three entries a day; lobby screens from mid-September show a counter out of 5, and keys bought in the mileage shop carry the count above the cap. Extra keys only matter for record attempts.

rules.title: Every cookie enters; the top 40 by power deploy first
rules.body: No formation, no pet choice and no manual control. All owned cookies enter; the 40 with the highest combat power deploy at once and each death brings in the next by power. The 40 earn nearly the whole score, so players set levels to decide who is in the 40. The in-game label about the first 40 disappeared on 2026-09-23, but the rule still holds.

rules.title: Scoring and the timer
rules.body: The score is the damage dealt to the Holy Golden Drop, which has no HP bar: the HUD shows the running score and a countdown from up to a minute. The run ends when the timer reaches 0 or every cookie is dead; result screens show the time left (0.000 s to about 6 s in top runs). Score milestones pay rewards from 400,000 points up to 1,000,000,000,000.

rules.title: Rankings, resets and rewards
rules.body: Each server has its own boards. The weekly board keeps the week's best run and closes Wednesday 00:00 KST; the daily board ranks each day's best run and closes at midnight. Rewards arrive by mail the next day 12:00-13:00 KST. The first run of the day pays a daily reward of 10,000 XP and 3,000 of a gem currency; the daily board pays research stones, one-minute speed-ups and, in the top 10, pet tickets; the weekly board pays coins, XP and, in the top 10, crystals; holding the weekly top 100 earns the 황금빛 광채 title; score milestones pay crystals and cosmetics.

rules.title: No power penalty reported
rules.body: No source reports a recommended-power gate like the stage's: score scales with the collection's power and levels, and players compare runs by score ÷ total power only as a normaliser.
